title: Veriqa HTTP channel wire, version 1
description: The wire contract between Veriqa and an external channel adapter, version 1 (status: preview). A document is checked against one of the entry points in $defs: call_envelope (a call of Veriqa to the adapter), <operation>_response (the answer of the adapter to that call) or event_envelope (an event the adapter posts to Veriqa). The normative text is the specification of the wire; this schema is derived from it. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere, and the values of variant, reason, outcome, display_intent, purpose, anomaly_reason_key, secondary_action, action, operation, event and error code are open: a receiver that does not know a value behaves as the specification declares.

wire_version.description: Version of the wire of the sender, major.minor; a document of this schema carries major version 1.

e164_phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164: the leading plus and 1 to 15 digits, the first not zero; no separators. Veriqa does not repair a number in another spelling: the event that carries it is not processed.

message_ref.description: Coordinates of a message in the channel.

call_envelope.description: Envelope of a call of Veriqa to the adapter: POST to the base URL of the registration.

operation.description: send-prompt, send-message, report-outcome, deep-link or health; an unknown operation is answered with the error unsupported_operation.

channel_type.description: Channel type of the registration: one entry point may serve several registrations.

tenant.description: Tenant of the call; null — the implicit tenant.

adapter_settings.description: Opaque settings string of the registration for the tenant of the call; null — none.

prompt.description: Structured context of the confirmation. An unknown variant is shown as a prompt without details.

brand_name.description: Brand name the owners of the transaction state, as configured — a Natural Key the question translates into the language of the recipient; null — none is stated. An adapter that does not know the field ignores it.

initiated_at.description: Moment the transaction was initiated, RFC 3339 in UTC.

requested_at.description: Moment the transaction was created — the time of the request the question shows, RFC 3339 in UTC; null — the context states none. An adapter that does not know the field ignores it.

anomaly_reason_key.description: Natural Key of the reason of the anomaly; null — the flag alone. An unknown key is the flag without a reason.

channel_identity.description: Channel snapshot of the account the question is asked of, in the shape of the identity of an event; null — no account is known. Its delivery_address is always null: the snapshot has no delivery address. An adapter that does not know the field ignores it.

channel_name.description: Name of the channel the question is asked in, in the language of the text; null — the channel is not known.

bot_name.description: Name under which the user sees the chat of the channel; null — the channel states none.

reason.description: initiator_snapshot_unavailable, display_disabled_by_configuration or confirmation_template_unavailable; diagnostics only. An unknown reason is suppressed without a reason.

ownership.description: Owners of the transaction; every field may be null or absent.

rendered_prompt.description: The prompt rendered by Veriqa, in plain text.

locale.description: Language the text is rendered in.

kind.description: Kind of the content — always one the registration declares.

phone_number_request.description: Content of the request for the phone number: an object exactly when kind is phone_number_request, null for every other kind. The schema does not tie the member to kind; Veriqa keeps the two together.

share_button_label.description: Caption of the button that shares the phone number, localized by Veriqa.

secondary_action.description: The secondary action of the step: skip or cancel_sign_in.

secondary_button_label.description: Caption of the button of the secondary action, localized by Veriqa.

claim_form_link.description: Content of the link to the claim completion form: an object exactly when kind is claim_form_link, null for every other kind. The url carries the form token and is a secret: the adapter never logs it. The schema does not tie the member to kind; Veriqa keeps the two together.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the form page, the form token included.

button_label.description: Caption of the button that opens the form, localized by Veriqa.

action_buttons.description: Buttons drawn under the text: an object exactly when kind is action_buttons, null for every other kind. The schema does not tie the member to kind; Veriqa keeps the two together.

buttons.description: Buttons in the order they are displayed; never empty.

action_button.description: One button of an action message: a link the platform opens, or an item of the menu whose press the adapter posts as menu_item_pressed. Exactly one of url and menu_item_value is a string, the other is null.

label.description: Caption of the button, localized by Veriqa.

url.description: Address a link button opens; null for an item of the menu. It may carry a single-use handle of the transaction and is a secret: the adapter never logs it.

menu_item_value.description: Value of an item of the menu, carried back by menu_item_pressed; null for a link button. The adapter builds the payload of the platform button itself.

outcome.description: confirmed, declined, expired or failed — terminal outcomes; awaiting_claims — not terminal: the sign-in is confirmed and waits for the claims it still lacks. An unknown outcome is shown as a terminal outcome by status_text.

inbound_token.description: Opaque token of the inbound event the outcome answers; null — none.

prompt_message.description: Coordinates of the prompt of the transaction; null — none.

phone_request_message.description: Coordinates of the message that asked the user for a phone number, when the step it belongs to is over; optional, null — none. Stated with a terminal outcome only.

display_intent.description: replace_prompt or new_message; an unknown intent is new_message.

purpose.description: Where the link is going to be used: button, hop_qr or direct_qr. The core always sends it; an adapter that does not know the field ignores it, and an unknown value is button.

rendered.description: The text to prefill the link with, rendered by Veriqa from the deeplink-prefill template of the purpose, in plain text; null or absent — Veriqa has no text for this link, and the adapter uses its own. The text carries the sign-in code only where the template states it: an adapter whose inbound side needs a marker adds it when it is missing. An adapter that does not know the field ignores it.

locale.description: Language the text is rendered in.

response_envelope.description: Envelope of the answer of the adapter: status 200, the version and exactly one of result and error.

error.description: Refusal of the operation by the adapter.

code.description: channel_cannot_continue, message_send_failed, channel_not_available, deep_link_generation_failed, unsupported_wire_version, unsupported_operation; other codes are allowed.

message.description: Coordinates of the sent message; null or absent — the channel has no addressable reference.

shown.description: true — the outcome is shown; false — the channel deliberately showed nothing.

url.description: Deep link of the transaction: an absolute URI of https or of a scheme the registration admits, up to 2048 characters; the same for every call on one transaction.

wire_version.description: The highest wire version the adapter supports.

event_envelope.description: Envelope of an event the adapter posts to POST /api/channels/{channel}/webhook or .../webhook/{tenant}. An unknown event is treated as unrelated.

event.description: auth_start, auth_start_by_code, auth_confirm, auth_decline, phone_shared, phone_step_action, menu_item_pressed, unaddressed or unrelated.

code.description: The code the user sent, without the wrapper of the message template of the registration; neither normalized nor checked for length by the adapter. Posted only by a registration that declares the start by a code; the event names no transaction.

inbound_token.description: Opaque token Veriqa returns in report-outcome; optional.

action.description: The secondary action of the phone step the user chose: skip or cancel_sign_in.

menu_item_value.description: The menu_item_value of the pressed button as send-message carried it. An empty value or one longer than 1024 characters makes the event unrelated. The event names no transaction; the webhook-id of the delivery is the identifier of the press.

text.description: Text of the message; optional. A button without a payload arrives as the text of its caption.

identity.description: Identity of the user in the channel.

delivery_address.description: Delivery address when it differs from channel_user_id.

raw_metadata.description: Channel metadata, a JSON object of at most 4 KB.

additional_claims.description: Claims of the adapter: name to string value.
